name: cowart-thinking-canvas
description: An AI canvas that turns requests into Excalidraw-style native editable diagrams.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a request into an Excalidraw-style diagram you can keep editing.
interface.longDescription: Yogurt AI turns text, the active page, or an exact selection into an Excalidraw-style diagram made from native editable cards, text, frames, and bound arrows. The Agent uses source-aware context and html-line-svg layout rules to choose reading order, spacing, ports, and obstacle-free routes, then validates collisions and bounds before writing to the canvas. Every generated element remains individually selectable, movable, resizable, editable, deletable, and reconnectable.
capabilities: Native editable cards, frames, text, and bound arrows
Deterministic html-line-svg layout and collision checks
defaultPrompt: Open Yogurt AI for this project.
Turn this requirement into an Excalidraw-style native editable diagram on the current canvas.
Organize the selected notes into editable cards, frames, and bound arrows without creating an image or PRD.
Improve this selected diagram while preserving my text edits and stable object IDs.
